name: HGCQA
description: Most existing complex question answering (CQA) datasets are designed for open-domain scenarios and primarily focus on the English language, while Chinese datasets in vertical domains remain scarce. To address this gap, this paper introduces a Chinese benchmark for CQA, focusing on two main domains, Chinese history and geography. The benchmark dataset, named HGCQA, comprises 10,103 question-answer-type triples and categorizes questions into eight distinct types of complexity.
